Name: Personal Effects Continued
Author: aylisarip
Description:
[b]Personal Effects[/b] could be considered a mod to improve the immersion of the game. It probably won't be. But it could. With this mod installed, some of your friendly village cohabitants will be a bit less careful with their, well, personal effects.  You might just occasionally catch a glimpse of an article of clothing left strewn out on the bedroom floor.

[b][size=5]FEATURES[/size][/b][b]

[/b][b]Personal Effects[/b] will spawn rarely for each supported NPC. These objects are cleared each [s]day[/s] week(for now), they don't accumulate. Collect, return, gift... or eat.
Eating a character’s undies changes your relationship with them, obvs.

Configure NPCs on/off, change genders, even cross-dressing, now with GMCM support.
Configure spawn rarity.
By default it is Very Rare, chances are:
5% to spawn in the bedroom
2% inside and near the house
1% in other spots and bathhouse
Rare - all rates are 2x, Normal - 3x, Often - 4x, Very Often - 5x, Always - well.. always. 

Multiple items per NPC means there are plenty of items to find. Items might be found in the NPC's room (or home), around the bathhouse, or just occasionally, somewhere unexpected.

20 quests added.

[b][size=5]QUESTS[/size][/b][b]
[/b][b]
[/b]Help reunite the Valley with their lost underpants. For some reason, every time you reach 2-❤️ friendship with an NPC they need your help with an undies-related crisis. You're not sure why, but it's honest work and you learn a lot about their personal lives. Some of the spawn locations are very well-hidden, so the quests will give you useful clues if you're trying to complete a collection. It's also a way to play through the content while being respectful of characters' consent.
